status.offlineBanner: You are offline. Your reports are saved on this device and will upload automatically when you reconnect.

welcome.title: Report damage in your community
welcome.intro: Help responders find people and damaged buildings. A report takes about a minute and needs no account.
welcome.offlineReady: Works offline — you can report even with no signal.

privacy.statement: Your report is anonymous. No personal information is stored or shared.

analyst.placeholderBody: The analyst dashboard (map, flags, exports) is being built in a later step.

a.publicHint: This public overview shows only grouped totals by area — never individual reports. Switch to Analyst records (access key required) to see full detail.
a.exportsSoon: Export tools (CSV, GeoJSON, GeoPackage, PDF) are added in the next build step.

login.title: Analyst access
login.body: Full records, photos and exports are restricted. Enter the analyst access key to continue.
login.label: Access key
login.error: That access key was not accepted. Please try again.

export.title: Export & share
export.intro: Downloads include the records matching the filters above.
export.apiHint: Authenticated GeoJSON endpoint — send the header x-analyst-key. Example:
export.autoPdf: {{count}} area(s) reached the auto-summary threshold ({{n}} reports within {{r}} m). Generate a PDF from the map view below.

photos.title: Add photos
photos.subtitle: A photo lets us assess the damage. One clear photo of the building is enough — more is better.

guidance.title: How to take a useful photo
guidance.l1: Capture the full building from the front.
guidance.l2: Take a second close-up of any visible damage.
guidance.l3: Stand in front of the main entrance for best GPS accuracy.
guidance.l4: Do not photograph people — faces and personal details are not needed and this protects your privacy.

location.title: Confirm the location
location.subtitle: This places your report on the map. No method is required — use whatever you can.
location.gpsDenied: Your location couldn't be found automatically because permission was denied. Tap your location on the map below, or type a nearby landmark to continue.
location.gpsUnavailable: Your location couldn't be found automatically. Tap your location on the map below, or type a nearby landmark to continue.
location.tapMap: Or tap the map to drop a pin
location.landmarkPlaceholder: e.g. near the blue mosque on the main road
location.methodUnknown: Not set — an analyst can follow up
location.landmarkApprox: Approximate — pinned to the current map area; an analyst will refine it from your landmark.
location.noBlock: To continue, set your location: use your current location, tap the map, or describe a nearby landmark.

hazard.title: What kind of emergency is this?
hazard.subtitle: Pick the closest match. This tailors the questions that follow.

safety.chemical: Do not approach the structure. Report from a safe distance only.

assess.title: Damage assessment
assess.subtitle: Our AI suggests a damage level from your photo. You have the final say — confirm or change it.
assess.mockNote: Prototype estimate — a sample AI result is shown because no AI key is configured.
assess.confirmHint: Confirm or correct the damage level below.
assess.offline: You are offline — the AI assessment is skipped. Please choose the damage level yourself.
assess.noPhoto: No photo was added — please choose the damage level yourself.
assess.failed: The AI assessment could not run. Please choose the damage level yourself.

damage.minimalDesc: No structural damage, or only hairline cosmetic cracks.
damage.partialDesc: Cracking, leaning or partial failure — damaged but standing.
damage.completeDesc: Collapse, severe leaning or displacement — unsafe.

infra.commercialDesc: Markets, malls, shops, hotels, banks, industry
infra.governmentDesc: Administrative buildings, courthouses, police, fire stations
infra.utilityDesc: Water pumps, power plants, waste treatment
infra.transportDesc: Roads, cell towers, bridges, railway and bus stations
infra.communityDesc: Schools, hospitals, community halls, public toilets

questions.title: A few quick questions
questions.descPlaceholder: Describe what you see, in any language.

mandatory.question: Are there people trapped or in danger near this location?

eq.1: Are there visible cracks in the walls or columns?
eq.2: Is road access to this location blocked?

flood.1: Approximate water level at this structure
flood.2: Is road or bridge access passable?

hur.1: Is the roof partially or fully missing?
hur.2: Are there downed power lines nearby?

fire.1: Is fire still active near this location?

tsu.1: Is water still present at this location?

conf.1: Is this location safe to approach?
conf.2: Are there visible blast or impact marks?

exp.1: Are there visible fumes or unusual odours?

review.title: Review your report
review.subtitle: Check the details, then submit. You can go back to change anything.
review.priorityNote: This report will be flagged as priority for responders.
review.step4Pending: Report assembled successfully. Saving and the offline queue are added in the next build step.

confirm.noLocation: No location was set for this report.
confirm.priority: This report was flagged as priority for responders.
